description:
Twelve stops in prehistoric oceans, one night each: Doug gets a time machine and a snorkel and has to last until sunrise against the sea monsters of the Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Cenozoic, from Anomalocaris and Dunkleosteus to Livyatan and Megalodon, the highest-ranking predator ever measured.

Which era should Doug visit next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad night.
